## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `99eaf835091373dde2a9b0bcd84f24fa0ff5b5d1`
Local-runs: none
Scope: AGENTS.md, .github/workflows/pr-automation.yml + scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs, scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs, scripts/release-github-releases.mjs, docs/releases-maintenance.md

Inputs read, and nothing else: card #25105 (body, claim comment 6314107974, os-dev-report comment 6315700975 — no ruling comment beyond the body); PR #25114 (body, the 8-file list, the net diff `origin/main...99eaf8350`, merge base `5050442bb9`, three commits); the 45 check-runs on `99eaf8350`, read at 2026-10-21T12:29:36Z: 32 `success`, 13 `skipped`, none failed, none in progress. The five required contexts: `Lint & Repo Gates` success (it carries `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:objectui-changeset`, `check:release-body`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:pm-dispatch-gates`), `TypeScript Type Check` success, `Test Core` success (6 of 6 shards), `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success, `Build Core` skipped (no `packages/**` path moves). `Check Changeset` success on the head. Those conclusions are the gate verdicts here; nothing was run locally.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The rule text restates ruling A — right.** `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` "WHICH LEVEL" carries all four parts the card body states: the four-row table in the ruling's own words (added: new authorable key, accepted value or enum member, metadata type; narrowed: key removed or tombstoned, value refused, requirement tightened; semantic: meaning or default of an authorable key; none: description or error text, non-authorable internal types, REST, drivers, services, console, `feat:` and `fix!:` alike), the `.strict()` rationale sentence, "a non-protocol breaking change ships `patch` and KEEPS its carriers: the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 disposition are unchanged", and the five release-note sections in the ruling's order and script. The old `fix(` that widens an index is `minor` paragraph and the commit-type discriminator are gone, as the amendment requires. `AGENTS.md` item 3 carries the table (condensed: "enum member" folds into "accepted value", the ④ example list is dropped) plus the carriers sentence, and drops the old `yes` takes at least `minor` coupling; it does not carry the `.strict()` rationale or the five sections. I read that as right, not a gap: the file's own header makes it rules-only, it sits at its 1117-line ceiling (held, max 119 bytes a line, `check:pm-skill-ratchet` green), card item 3 asks for a restatement "from the table above", and the rationale and sections live where the author who is refused reads them (WHICH LEVEL) and in `docs/releases-maintenance.md`. Both files now name both declaration lines and say `check:adr-0087-registration` reads the arm and the kind. The one thing the ruling does not state and the text adds: the precedence `narrowed` over `semantic` over `added` when several kinds apply — a tie-break the one-token line needs, pointing in the direction that keeps the BREAKING carriers; right.
   One prose nit, not a verdict: WHICH LEVEL says a PR "that introduces a changeset entry with no readable `Metadata-protocol:` line is refused as NOT MEASURED (exit 1)". The gate's inherited #16776 moot lane still exits 0 for a `patch` entry on a package the diff does not move (the new self-test matrix pins exactly that). The sentence overstates the gate by that one edge; the gate is the correct side. A one-clause follow-up edit ("an entry the kind would grade").

2. **The gate enforces that text, no looser and no stricter than ruling A re-rules — right.** `judgeLevel` read against the table: a kind owes at least one moved package `minor`+ (`enforce` / `discharged` / `clean`, the #16361 grain, #16713 depth, #16692 root and #15204 copy legs inherited unchanged — their fixtures re-driven with `Metadata-protocol: added` where they drove `Clause-②: yes`); `none` owes `patch` on every introduced entry, any package (`none-minor`), and may not move a shard under `packages/spec/authorable-surface/` or `authorable-defaults/` (`none-baseline-moved`; `baselinesTouched` reads the 14 + 13 shard files that exist on `main` with a trailing-slash prefix, so `authorable-surface.base.json` is excluded — the card's "where the existing ratchets can see it", and the refusal names the shard and the three kinds that would be true); `added` under `Clause-②: no` and `narrowed` beside a read `Clause-②:` line with no `(narrowing)` arm are `contradiction`, each with its own reason and remedy, and neither line is inferred from the other. The #16776 materiality is kept on the `Clause-②` line byte-for-byte (`value === null && refusable`) and widened to the kind (`refusable`, any `minor`+, or a moved baseline). **What loosened is exactly the two couplings ruling A re-rules**: `Clause-②: yes` and the `(narrowing)` arm no longer force `minor` — under a declared `none` they read `none-clean` at `patch` with the BREAKING carriers stated untouched. `not-declared` (a bare `no` stands the axis down, exit 0) is removed in the stricter direction: a bare `no` with no kind is `not-measured-material` on a material tree. The launch-window major guard (`scan` / `judge` / `render`), the protocol-lockstep evidence and `scan()`'s "introduced entries only" reading (base-side entries subtracted per package and bump) are not in the diff. **No new gate**: no new script, workflow step or job; the new verdicts live inside the existing level axis as card item 2 asks, and the body is read on `opened`, `synchronize` and `edited` as before (the `types:` list is untouched). Self-test: new battery "Ruling A: the metadata-protocol kind is the level axis" at floor 30, roster 21 to 22, driven through the real reader and real temp repositories; `check:changeset-gate-self-tests` green in CI.
   Nit: `baselinesTouched` swallows a `git diff` failure into `moved: []`. Practically unreachable — `scan()` has just run the same `from..head` diff and throws on a bad merge base — but the shape is a silent stand-down where `packagesTouched` returns an `unreadable` list; a later tidy, not a finding against this head.

3. **The declaration carrier — right.** Sibling line `Metadata-protocol: added | narrowed | semantic | none` in `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`, the choice and its reason stated in the PR as the card asks. `readMetadataProtocolLine` reuses the key-line shape, decoration tolerance, value-token calibration and the describing / inline-key / spelling triage, parameterised on key and closed set; `readClause2Line`'s body is untouched (the three shared helpers gained a defaulted parameter), so every existing declaration reads as before. The module still imports nothing. The reading is four-valued like its sibling, and none of malformed, near-miss or absent is read as `none` — the gate decides what an unread kind costs.

4. **`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` — right.** `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` on the changeset body is the fifth breaking signal; `added`, `semantic`, `none` and a malformed kind add none; convention-rot fixtures pin both directions and run on every real scan. A strictly tighter reading of an existing gate, consistent with "non-protocol breaking changes keep their carriers" (a protocol narrowing is a break by the ruling's own definition). Not a new gate.

5. **`scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs` — right** (card item 4). The console refresh changeset is `patch` whatever objectui declared, in RC pre-mode too; `CONSOLE_BUMP` still overrides; the declared level is derived, reported in the body ("declared X, recorded as patch") and on stderr; the generated file carries `Metadata-protocol: none` at column 0 so the gate and the release notes read it. `inPreMode` stays exported with no caller left in `scripts/` — named in the PR, harmless. `docs/releases-maintenance.md` now states this grade, which it previously stated the other way.

6. **`scripts/release-github-releases.mjs` — right, with one interpretive widening named for the maintainer's Tier H read.** The GitHub Release body is the CHANGELOG section regrouped under the five headings in the ruling's order and words (an English gloss after a dash on each); `CHANGELOG.md` stays as `changeset version` writes it; the splitter is fence-aware and opens a bullet only at a column-0 `- `, pinned on the real `16.1.0` section (same bullet count before and after); `planRelease` posts the grouped body through the unchanged truncation path; `check:release-body` green. The widening: 需手动处理 / 自动迁移 take every BREAKING signal the ADR-0087 gate reads — the banner, a `!` summary, the `(narrowing)` arm, `narrowed` — where the card's bullet literally says "narrowed". So a non-protocol breaking change (a REST or driver narrowing at `patch`) lands under 需手动处理 with its kept banner rather than under 其他修复. I judge that right: the ruling's organising principle is "what the reader must do", ruling A keeps the BREAKING banner on exactly these entries, and filing a kept banner under "other fixes" would bury it; the mechanism is the dev's call by card item 5. It is the one place the implementation reads the ruling's intent over its letter — maintainer, if you meant 需手动处理 for protocol narrowings only, this is the line to say so on. 新增能力 also takes a non-breaking `Clause-②: yes` with `none` (a new REST endpoint); `docs/releases-maintenance.md` says so; the code docblock says "with no protocol kind", narrower than the code — a comment nit. Only a `registered` ADR-0087 disposition (the HTML-comment marker, read by the same spelling the ADR-0087 gate uses) moves an entry to 自动迁移; `not-required` leaves it under 需手动处理 — right, the reader still acts.

7. **Governed landing.** Hits `AGENTS.md` and `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` make the whole PR Tier H; it is a draft with both `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` requested. This record is the contract-tier reading; it does not lift Tier H — the maintainer's approval does, and the queue guard (green on the head) will still want it.

### ② Semver level

- **`skip-changeset` — right.** Every changed path is `scripts/**`, `.github/**`, `docs/**` or `AGENTS.md`; the root package is private; no published package's `files[]` or build reaches any of the five scripts (the only `scripts/` paths reached from `packages/**` are the build helpers `check-dts-emitted`, `tsup-drop-sources-content`, `check-test-typecheck`, `import-prerequisite`). No `.changeset/` file in the diff — the pending stock is not regraded (card item 6), so 18.1.0 is unaffected.
- **`Clause-②: no` — right**: no accept set or public surface of a published payload moves (the PR's parenthetical is reasoning, not an arm).
- **`Metadata-protocol: none` — right**: nothing a metadata author writes changes; the new line is a PR-body and changeset-body declaration, not a schema key, and moves no `authorable-surface/` or `authorable-defaults/` shard. Under its own gate this PR reads `none-clean` (no introduced entry, no baseline moved) and `Check Changeset` is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev's `deviations`, each answered:
1. Attribution: all three commits end with `Claude-Session:` and the model-free `Co-authored-by: Claude` trailer; no model identifier anywhere in the diff or PR body. Accepted; the harness reminder is the exemption AGENTS.md names.
2. `no-path-population` marker dropped from `release-github-releases.mjs`: in-claim file; the `clause2-line.mjs` import is now that family's one true path population and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` is green (1913/1913 by the report, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` success). Accepted.
3. `docs/releases-maintenance.md` edited off the claim's list: prose that stated the console grade the digest no longer produces, plus the five-section table; not a governed surface, no gate reads it, and the card's release-notes bullet names "the docs release page if one exists". Accepted as a named rider.
4. H4 transition reading: informational, not a verdict. Accepted; carrier the seat.
5. Label read-back: the relay line named no label; the independent GET lists `skip-changeset` and `size/xl` and `Check Changeset` passed on the head. The GET is the read-back of record for the label leg; the relay's missing leg is a fleet-write reporting gap outside this PR. Accepted.

`out_of_scope_findings`, each answered:
1. The `.claude/**` claim template, `os-dev.md` and the pm-dispatch references still spell the declaration as `Clause-②` alone — **escalated to the seat**: until they carry `Metadata-protocol:`, every dispatched PR with a changeset reds `not-measured-material` once and clears by one body line. Out of this claim by the claim's own text; a Tier S skills-lane card should land close behind this PR. Not a FAIL here.
2. The 10 open PRs with changesets turn `not-measured-material` on landing; four carry non-protocol minors ruling A grades `patch` — **escalated to the seat** for per-PR notes by the owning lanes. The #25099 borderline (a platform object's field option set) is the maintainer's to rule; the PR's 维护者速读 already asks it.
3. `annotate-shipped`'s lead line — observation, no action owed.

`open_questions`: none declared, none found. My own flags: the WHICH LEVEL "refused as NOT MEASURED" overstatement (①.1) and the `baselinesTouched` silent-stand-down shape (①.2) are follow-up nits; the release-notes "breaking" widening (①.6) is for the maintainer's eye at the Tier H read.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-25105-changeset-protocol-levels`
Reviewed-by: `session_01VsqhiSrBjB1wJfRNcHPeXN`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读 · `domain:spec` seat 1 · 2026-10-21T12:33Z

**改了什么。** 按您 2026-10-21 的裁决 A 落地「版本号只跟元数据协议走」。每个 PR 和 changeset 在 `Clause-②:` 旁边多写一行 `Metadata-protocol: added | narrowed | semantic | none`。门禁 `check-changeset-no-major` 据此判级:协议新增、收窄、语义变化 ⇒ 至少一个被改的包 `minor`;`none` ⇒ 一律 `patch`,带 `minor` 即拒;改了 `authorable-surface/`、`authorable-defaults/` 基线却声明 `none` 也拒。console 刷新的 changeset 固定 `patch`。GitHub Release 正文按「需手动处理 / 自动迁移 / 新增能力 / 语义变化 / 其他修复」五段重排(CHANGELOG 本身不动)。AGENTS.md 第 3 条与 `pr-automation.yml` 的 "WHICH LEVEL" 规则文字同步改写。

**为什么改。** 现在几乎每次发版都是 minor:约一半待发 changeset 是 minor,真正动了元数据协议的只有十来个,版本号说不出协议动没动。裁决 A 把 minor 留给协议变化。「新增」也算 minor,因为 spec schema 不是 `.strict()`,旧运行时会静默丢掉不认识的键,用新键的应用要能写出一个 minor 底线。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。**
- 过渡:现开的 12 个 PR 里有 10 个带 changeset,本 PR 合并当天都会在这个门禁上读到「未声明」而红。每个在正文补一行即清,不用推送;其中 4 个是非协议的 minor,按新规要改成 patch。合并时席位逐个通知所属车道。
- 派发流程:认领模板和 os-dev 定义还不认识新行,已立 #25115 交 skills 车道,应紧随本 PR 落地;在那之前,新派发的 PR 都会先红一次再补行。
- 一处按意图而非字面落地:Release 正文的「需手动处理」收所有带 BREAKING 标记的条目,包括非协议的 REST、driver 收窄,而裁决原文这一段写的是 narrowed。理由是这些条目按裁决保留了 BREAKING 标记,读者确实要处理,放进「其他修复」会被埋掉。
- 基线检查只看得见键名和默认值;拒值、枚举收窄、语义变化仍靠作者如实声明。
- 回滚:整个 PR revert 即可,无数据迁移,不发布任何包(`skip-changeset`)。

**席位意见。** 建议批准。上限档契约复审 PASS(记录 `6315965482`,head `99eaf8350`);同一 head 上 45 个检查 32 绿、13 跳过、0 红。规则文字与裁决 A 的四行表一致;门禁只放开了裁决 A 明确改掉的两处耦合(`Clause-②: yes` 和 `(narrowing)` 不再强制 minor),其它判定一条没放松,也没有新增门禁。复审提的两处小瑕疵(WHICH LEVEL 有一句把一个边角情形说得比门禁严;一个读不到的 git 失败会被静默当作「没动基线」)不影响判定,随本 PR 下一次代码推送带上;若没有下一次推送,另行跟进。

**你要做的。** 在 PR #25114 上批准(重点看 AGENTS.md 第 1084–1101 行和 `pr-automation.yml` 的 "WHICH LEVEL" 段);批准后席位过落地前检、转 ready、入队。若您要「需手动处理」只收协议收窄,改为在 PR 上留一句,席位按此返工。

## 席位核对

Seat record of `domain:spec` seat 1 (seat post #6017) · session `session_01VsqhiSrBjB1wJfRNcHPeXN` · verdict **ACCEPT (Tier H: awaits an authorized approval; not readied, not queued)** · head `99eaf835091373dde2a9b0bcd84f24fa0ff5b5d1`.

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #25105`; `Clause-②: no (…)` and `Metadata-protocol: none (…)` at line start; 8 files, +1347 / −295 (`check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 25114`: Tier H on `AGENTS.md` and `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`, 1642 changed lines ≤ 3000); assignee `huangyiirene`; reviewers `hotlong` and `os-zhuang` requested (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`); labels `skip-changeset` (right: every path is `scripts/**`, `.github/**`, `docs/**` or `AGENTS.md`, no package's `files[]` reaches them), `size/xl`, `documentation`, `ci/cd`.
2. **Premises measured.** Before the claim, on `origin/main` `5050442bb9`: every path the card names exists; "WHICH LEVEL" at `pr-automation.yml:754`; the `Clause-②` sentence at `AGENTS.md:1087`; no open PR and no in-flight claim in any lane touched the surface. The dev re-measured H1–H5 at the same base (PR body, "Measured against the dispatch hypotheses").
3. **Gate check-runs** (head-pinned, read 2026-10-21T12:33Z): 45 runs, 32 `success`, 13 `skipped`, 0 failed, 0 in progress. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (6/6), `Check Changeset` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` all `success`. Contract review of record: `6315965482`, `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, rules face, **PASS** on this head, adopted by this seat.
4. **Accepted deviations.**
   - `docs/releases-maintenance.md` is off the claim's list. It is a prose rider stating the new console grade and the five sections; the seat read both hunks sentence by sentence against the diff (the `bump-objectui.sh` paragraph; the new "Release notes are grouped by what the reader must do" table), and both match the code.
   - `AGENTS.md` item 3 was condensed to stay at its 1117-line ceiling. The two dropped retirement details live in the skill the item defers to: `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` (the `*_RETIRED_KEY_GUIDANCE` row, and the tombstone-keeps-its-ledger-row table), read on `origin/main`.
   - `check:release-body`'s `no-path-population` marker was dropped; the reader import makes `clause2-line.mjs` that family's path population; `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` is `success`.
   - The relay's `pr_create` read-back named no label; an independent GET lists `skip-changeset` and `Check Changeset` passed. The GET is the read-back of record.
5. **Out-of-scope dispositions.**
   - Dev finding 1 (`.claude/**` claim template, `os-dev.md:280`, `execution-duties.md:70` carry only `Clause-②:`): **filed #25115**, `pm:blocked`, `Blocked-by: #25105`, for the skills lane.
   - Dev finding 2 (10 open PRs read `not-measured-material` on landing; 4 non-protocol minors to regrade): **seat landing duty**. One note per PR to its owning lane in the landing act (clause 6).
   - Dev finding 3 (`annotate-shipped` lead line): **dropped**. It is an observation with no wrong output; the release-body splitter reads the whole bullet.
   - Review nits ①.1 (WHICH LEVEL "refused as NOT MEASURED" overstates the inherited moot lane), ①.2 (`baselinesTouched` swallows a `git diff` failure) and ①.6 (a docblock narrower than the code): **ride this PR's next code push if one comes**, else a follow-up after landing.
6. **Landing clause.** Stays draft until an authorized approval (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`) is on record. Then, in one landing window: re-read CI on the then-current head, `mergeable_state`, and `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 25114`; remove `needs-user-decision`; relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`; confirm `added_to_merge_queue`; confirm MERGED on `origin/main`; post the transition note on each open PR that introduces a changeset; release #25115 for triage's unlock scan.
